background.fact: Placekicker for the Los Angeles Chargers, born May 6, 2000, listed at 6 ft 1 in, 216 lb, age 26, jersey 11, college Texas, undrafted in 2022 (signed by the Rams as an undrafted free agent), 5 years of experience, depth chart K1.

background.fact: Birthplace: the data file bio says Austin, TX, USA, but Wikipedia says he was born in Hong Kong and spent his first 11 years in Shanghai before his family moved to Austin in 2011. The sources disagree; the data file value (Austin) is kept as the listed value, and the Hong Kong claim is noted from Wikipedia (headline only from The Sporting Tribune, Oct 15, 2025: 'rise from Hong Kong to NFL history').

At Lake Travis High School in Austin he was a two-time all-state selection, starting kicker for three seasons and punter for two, won the Texas 6A Division I state title in 2016 with teammates Garrett Wilson and Charlie Brewer, and set a school record with a 53-yard field goal.

At Texas he won the starting job as a freshman, was named All-Big 12 kicker and punter, and holds the school record for field goals made; Gus Johnson of Fox Sports gave him the 'Dicker the Kicker' name after a game-winning 40-yard field goal against Oklahoma in the Red River Showdown. (Wikipedia elsewhere says a seventh grade science teacher gave him the nickname; the sources in the Wikipedia text differ on origin.)
background.confidence: from Wikipedia, with an internal inconsistency noted
